data.one_liner: A Dart CLI wrapper around openapi-generator to generate API client code.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the openapi-generator tool to automatically create API client libraries, server stubs, documentation, and configuration from an OpenAPI Specification.
use_when: You need to generate Dart or Flutter API client SDKs from an OpenAPI specification.
You want to use a CLI tool to automate API client code generation.
avoid_when: You prefer writing your network requests manually or using a runtime client like dio or http.
You do not use an OpenAPI specification for your backend.
strengths: Automates the creation of complex API client libraries from OpenAPI specs.
Provides a Dart CLI wrapper around the established openapi-generator tool.
weaknesses: Requires proper PATH configuration for global pub executables.
Generated code can sometimes require dependency overrides for version conflicts.
data.setup_notes: Install globally via dart pub global activate openapi_generator_cli and ensure the pub-cache/bin directory is in your PATH.

alternatives.name: retrofit
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer writing abstract Dart interfaces with annotations to generate REST client code using dio instead of generating from an OpenAPI spec file.

data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate openapi_generator_cli
openapi-generator generate -i http://127.0.0.1:8111/v3/api-docs -g dart
